chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Length of the Follies run and who was in it
summary: The Follies ran about 15 weeks; he names Hal Leroy, Mitzi Mayfair, Jack Pearl, Harry Richman, Helen Morgan and others, but he performed only with Buck.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: The Ziegfeld Follies lasted for one week, is that right?
And the Lafayette Theater was going on at the same time as this?
It was going on, but I wasn't working there -- we only had one week's contract with them.
Well, just in case we didn't mention it, who were some of the performers that were at the Ziegfeld Follies when you were there?
Hal Leroy, Mitzi Mayfair, Jack Pearl, Harry Richman, Frank and Mill Britton's Band, Helen Morgan, Faith Bacon -- I can't think of nobody else.
Okay. Nonetheless you still just performed with Buck, you didn't perform with any of these people.
